positions.name: GateAsAuthorityMandate
positions.frame: Is the Meridian signed-manifest gate constituted here as a rank-based mandate — imposed, labeled, scoped, and owned by positional authority — rather than as a negotiated or evidence-argued condition?
positions.why: Across these four expressions the directive to require a signed manifest (src-1) is restated as a bolded protocol label (src-3), its jurisdiction is extended by declarative scope-setting to staging and production (src-4), and accountability is fixed by a named-owner label (src-5). The relational and power reads mark all four as authority-ranking / legitimate-authority moves performed through restatement and labeling rather than through persuasion — a single directional thread distinct from src-2's separate, evidence-based justification move (rational-persuasion / market-pricing), which sits outside this read.
